changelog:
dropspace 1.0.3

- Expanded documentation with API setup, scopes overview, and platform-specific posting instructions.
- Added guidance on using least-privilege API keys and recommended scopes for common use cases.
- Outlined multi-platform social publishing support for 10+ networks with per-platform character/media limits.
- Detailed persona-based content creation, per-post analytics, scheduling options, and AI-generated content features.
- Described inline and storage media upload methods and platform-specific posting requirements.
